_notes: UNVERIFIED and capability-poor by nature: Aider's history file is a prose transcript,
not structured usage. Aider prints token counts to the terminal but does not persist
them in a machine-readable form by default. Until that changes this source will
correctly report 'no usable token signal' rather than fabricate numbers.
If you run Aider with --analytics, point this mapping at that file instead.
